Compare accuracy across multiple forecasts

Source: R/metrics.R
compare_accuracy.Rd

Takes several mort_forecast objects (or mort_accuracy objects) and returns a summary comparison table.

Usage

compare_accuracy(..., test = NULL)

Arguments

...

Named mort_forecast or mort_accuracy objects.

test

A mort_data object of observed test data. Required when passing mort_forecast objects. Ignored for mort_accuracy inputs.

Value

A data.table with one row per model and columns for each metric.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
compare_accuracy(
  "Tucker3-CoDa" = fc_coda,
  "Lee-Carter"   = fc_lc,
  "Ensemble"     = fc_ens,
  test = holdout_data
)
} # }
